named_events.event_name: multiple landfalling hurricanes in the United States
named_events.loss_description: The result was impacted by an above average year for natural catastrophe claims, across both the MGA and Reinsurance class particularly as a result of multiple landfalling hurricanes in the United States.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $745.531m. There is no quantified gross prior year reserve movement disclosed; analysis of the reported gross claims development table indicates effectively flat prior year development (no material release or strengthening). The 2021 underwriting result was driven by an above-average natural catastrophe year (multiple landfalling US hurricanes) which impacted current year claims rather than producing material prior-year reserve movements.
raw_causal_phrases: an above average year for natural catastrophe claims
multiple landfalling hurricanes in the United States

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note was located. Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (gross triangle) as a fallback and results in zero net movement. exact_reserve_text is empty because no single verbatim sentence quantifying gross prior year reserve movement was found. All amounts are in the report's native currency (USD) and presented in millions.
